He would write to Cork himself.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一台尚未重启的机器，路灯仍在执行昨夜的指令。环卫工人的扫帚声在空旷的街道上格外清晰。写字楼的轮廓浸在灰蓝色天光里，只有零星几扇窗还亮着。早餐铺的卷帘门哗啦拉起，蒸汽从蒸笼涌出，豆浆的香气爬过整条街。第一班公交碾过井盖，发出沉闷回响。天际线开始泛白，鸟鸣此起彼伏。这座城市在醒来之前，先学会了呼吸。", "w03": "• Imagine you are in a line of people and you ask the person in front what number they are; they ask the person in front of them, and so on — that is recursion.\n• Each person does the same tiny job: pass the question forward, then pass the answer back with one added.\n• It only works because it eventually stops — the last person in line just says 'I am number 1!' instead of asking anyone else."}
